title: Saturday Daily Practice

intro: Làm lần lượt các bước, khoảng 17 phút. Hôm nay: Vocab Quest ôn 8 từ xu hướng và một kỹ năng: Writing Task 1 (line graph). Đây là bài chuẩn bị cho buổi P5 Chủ nhật. Hạn nộp 23:30 cùng ngày: đủ và đúng hạn được 20 Meow, muộn hoặc làm một nửa được 10 Meow. Đừng xem đáp án trước khi làm xong.
send_today: Hoàn thành các bước trên web. Bài Writing ở Step 3 được thầy chấm. Voice note đọc Overview ở Step 4.

steps.title: Step 1 · Vocab Quest: choose the meaning (3 min)
steps.instructions: Review trend words (8): rocket · bottom out · marginal change · surge · recover · steep decline · plateau · plunge. Choose the correct meaning (A, B, C or D).

items.explain: rocket = tăng vọt rất nhanh. Example: House prices rocketed in the city centre.
bottom out = chạm đáy rồi ngừng giảm. Example: Unemployment bottomed out at 3% in 2019.
marginal change = thay đổi rất nhỏ. Example: There was only a marginal change in bus use.
surge = tăng vọt đột ngột. Example: Online sales surged in 2020.
recover = phục hồi. Example: Tourist numbers recovered after 2021.
steep decline = sự sụt giảm mạnh. Example: There was a steep decline in letter writing.
plateau = đi ngang sau khi tăng. Example: The figure plateaued at around 60%.
plunge = lao dốc, giảm mạnh. Example: Ticket sales plunged during the storm.

steps.title: Step 2 · Trend sentences (3 min)
steps.instructions: Complete each sentence with ONE word: the past simple of the verb in brackets, or a preposition (from, to, by, at).

items.label: 1. Hours spent on online study ______ (rise) steadily over the period.
2. In 2016, part-time work stood ______ 6 hours a week.
3. The figure for sport ______ (fall) slightly to 3 hours.
4. Online study increased ______ 2 hours ______ 12 hours. (two words)
5. Part-time work went up ______ 9 hours in total.
6. Time spent on sport ______ (remain) stable between 2022 and 2024.

steps.title: Step 3 · Writing: intro + overview + 1 body sentence (10 min)
steps.instructions: The line graph shows the average number of hours per week that students at a college spent on three activities from 2016 to 2024. Data: Part-time work 6, 8, 11, 14, 15 · Sport 5, 5, 4, 3, 3 · Online study 2, 4, 7, 10, 12 (2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024). Write the Intro + Overview + 1 Body sentence (about 80 words). Checklist: intro paraphrases what, who, where, when · overview has 2 sentences, no numbers · body sentence uses stood at and from … to · past simple. Support: The line graph illustrates … · Overall, … while … · It is also clear that … · In 2016, … stood at …, compared with … Challenge: add a second body sentence with surge or marginal change.

open.model: The line graph illustrates how many hours per week college students spent on part-time work, sport and online study between 2016 and 2024. Overall, the time spent on part-time work and online study increased, while the figure for sport fell slightly. It is also clear that part-time work took up the most time throughout the period. In 2016, students spent 6 hours a week on part-time work, compared with 5 hours on sport and only 2 hours on online study, which then rose from 2 to 12 hours by 2024.

steps.title: Step 4 · Voice note: read your Overview (30 s)
steps.instructions: Record yourself reading your Overview aloud, about 30 seconds. Say the final sounds clearly (-ed, -s).
steps.note: Thầy nghe âm cuối và thì quá khứ.
